Admissions at CCDS
Understand your pathway into CCDS before proceeding to the official NTU admissions pages.
■Education at CCDS
■Undergraduate
■Graduate
■Continuing Education
■Admissions
Admission to programmes at the College of Computing and Data Science (CCDS) follows NTU's university-wide requirements, alongside additional academic expectations specific to computing and data science disciplines.
Applicants are expected to demonstrate strong academic foundations, particularly in areas such as mathematics, physics, or computing, depending on the programme and level of study. These foundations are essential for succeeding in the rigour and pace of CCDS programmes.
This page provides an overview of the key admission pathways to help you understand where you fit, before proceeding to the official NTU admissions pages.
Admission Pathways
Undergraduate Admissions
For applicants applying to full-time undergraduate programmes in computing, data science, artificial intelligence, and engineering disciplines.
Applicants should be prepared for programmes that emphasise strong fundamentals, structured learning, and sustained intellectual engagement.
Explore Undergraduate Admissions
→
Graduate Admissions
For applicants pursuing postgraduate study by coursework or research, including master's and doctoral programmes.
Graduate applicants are expected to demonstrate academic readiness, relevant disciplinary grounding, and the capacity for advanced study or research.
Explore Graduate Admissions
→
Scholarships and Awards
For applicants exploring scholarships, awards, and financial support options linked to their programme of study.
Scholarships may be offered at the university level or in association with specific programmes.
Explore Scholarships and Awards
→
International Applicants
For applicants applying from overseas institutions.
International applicants should review qualification equivalency requirements, English language proficiency expectations, and programme-specific considerations before applying.
Information for International Applicants
